/members/members_present: Checks whether the Cloud API's list of organization members has any members.
/members/member_count: Counts the members in the Cloud API's list of organization members.
/admins/admins_present: Checks whether any listed member is an admin. A member is an admin when they hold the system Admin role, or when a console role they hold allows control-plane:organization:manage on the organization, control-plane:service:manage or control-plane:service:delete on every service, or control-plane:postgres-service:manage on every Postgres service, with no DENY policy on the same permission and resources.
/admins/admin_count: Counts the listed members who are admins. A member is an admin when they hold the system Admin role, or when a console role they hold allows control-plane:organization:manage on the organization, control-plane:service:manage or control-plane:service:delete on every service, or control-plane:postgres-service:manage on every Postgres service, with no DENY policy on the same permission and resources.
/admins/admin_share_pct: Divides admin_count by members.member_count, rounded up.
/credentials/credentials_present: Checks whether the Cloud API's list of API keys, every page included, has a key that is enabled and has not expired.
/credentials/credential_count: Counts the listed API keys that are enabled and whose expireAt, if set, is later than the run.
/credentials/never_expiring_credential_c: Counts the keys in credential_count that have no expireAt.
/credentials/never_expiring_pct: Divides never_expiring_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
/credentials/unused_credential_count: Counts the keys in credential_count with no usedAt, or with a usedAt more than 90 days before the run.
/credentials/unused_pct: Divides unused_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
/credentials/unrestricted_credential_cou: Counts the keys in credential_count that hold the system Admin role and have a 0.0.0.0/0 entry in ipAccessList. A key with any other role or with no such entry counts as restricted.
/credentials/unrestricted_pct: Divides unrestricted_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
/credentials/write_access_credential_cou: Counts the keys in credential_count that hold the system Admin role.
/credentials/write_access_pct: Divides write_access_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
/credentials/rotation_overdue_credential: Counts the keys in credential_count whose createdAt is more than 90 days before the run.
/credentials/rotation_overdue_pct: Divides rotation_overdue_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
